content: SheetJS xlsx npm registry package is stale (0.18.5, 2022) and carries known CVEs (CVE-2023-30533 prototype pollution, CVE-2024-22363 ReDoS). Current patched SheetJS code is 0.20.3+, distributed via cdn.sheetjs.com tarball or the community npm mirror @e965/xlsx. In Next.js, parse uploaded files in a Node.js-runtime Route Handler/Server Action via request.formData() -> ArrayBuffer, not Edge runtime.
